notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Been working on improving the progression system in the game. The construction on certain buildings will be locked out until the ship has enough passengers. Now the game prompts events regarding the newly unlocked buildings that encourage the player to build them as they are unlocked. This helps in keeping the ship running and passengers safe but also introduces the different buildings and systems in a more linear way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480987/4fc5db90a3179051d25278cda584b2b7d7b50391.png[/img]

Currently the development speed has been a bit slow due to real life things like studies for example, but it's moving on steadily forward.

notes.title: Playtesting in progress
notes.notes:
Playtesting is in progress and todo-list is filling with mostly with smaller bugs and quality of life improvements!

A lot of fixing and tweaking with the game speed and balance mostly to keep it relaxing enough to not quit playing altogether, but at the same time keeping it difficult and slow enough to feel the progression.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480987/59179b5d979a71dfe23a45b4d9e32f72108dbaa0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Pre-alpha playtesting has started!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40480987/1dbf5df999d5ad8ede7961908f5ec15741f48b92.jpg[/img]
Hello fellow space ship managers!

The pre-alpha testing phase has for Generation Nova has started. Currently most of the systems have been built in and the game is playable without any game breaking bugs. The next major milestone is to fine tune the balancing of resource production and building systems for an enjoyable game experience.

Tutorial system will be built after the testing phase. Be sure to stay updated on the news about the game by subscribing on Youtube and/or wishlisting the game!


[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC0fZn0XcjRZNxakHUXC277A]Oatcube Youtube[/url]
